notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content: Just a few attempts at bug fixes. Praying they work.

notes.title: Patch 13.02.2021
notes.content:
Balance patch to prepare for the upcoming tournament. Check the announcements channel in Discord for more information.

Harbinger Primary no longer activates instantly when triggered by Ghror Battle Standard.
Tulogg changed to: Taunt. If I leave your Story, I instead go home and then I return to your Hand after one turn has passed. I gain +2/+2 for the rest of the game.
-> This gives Tulogg the same protection Maul has.
Healing Rains healing to 3. Span to 5.
Carrion Sprites mana cost to 2N2D.
Five Words changed to: You may only play Five Words if you took damage during your Opponent’s last turn and if you and your Companions haven't dealt damage this turn. Until the start of your next turn, prevent all damage. Void Five Words.
Bebu Bumo secondary changed to: At the start of your turn, add up to 3 unspent mana from last turn to your mana pool until end of turn. (Oldest mana first.)
Bebu Bumo primary mana cost changed to 1N.
Batnarsh stats changed to 3/4.
Gift of Conviction to +4 attack. Mana cost 1N2A.

notes.title: Patch 10.02.2021
notes.content:
Added a second tutorial. This tutorial focuses mostly on mana costs but also covers a variety of different topics.

UI bug fixes: Knife Made Wise Companion position bug; tooltip length setting resetting; Spells not playable on the whole board; right clicking cards to remove them from your deck responsiveness; item info going outside the screen.

notes.title: Patch 07.02.2021
notes.content:
Improved Bot AI significantly. They should now behave much more similar to actual players. In this process we have reduced the amount of decks available to the bots for now, we’ll be increasing this again in the future.

Fixed a few bugs exclusive to single player.

Fixed a variety of multiplayer bugs.

Improved matchmaking, specifically connecting to a server.

[b]We would also like to give you a brief overview over what our immediate priorities are:[/b]

Fixing UI bugs.

Further work on connectivity issues.

Improving the friend challenge system.

notes.title: Patch #2 05.02.2021
notes.content:
A few language fixes for both English and Chinese localization.

Awkward Serendipity changed to: Secretly target a Page. The next time during your Opponents turn, a Companion in that Page would take damage, prevent it. The Companion can't take damage until the start of your next turn.

Mangarchitect bot cards now cost 1N more. This has no impact on the hero ability.

notes.title: Patch 05.02.2021
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with tooltip selection.
[*] Fixed bug with Civatakh Elder token art.
[*] Mulligan buttons now get hidden after making your selection.
[*] You can now see your opponents floating mana.
[*] Untargeted Spells now have a selection highlight.
[*] You can now left click on your cards in hand instead of dragging them.
[*] You can now right click cards in the match history.
[*] You can now right click cards while your opponent is making a selection.
[*] Added VFX for: Duvdank-Gugu Ultimate, Wears-Many-Minds Ultimate and The Envoy Ultimate.
[*] Improved Chinese translation.
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]

[list]
[*] Grahdaza Hima changed to “The first Spell each turn you play from your Hand is played an additional time. After I attack, you may play a Spell from your Ashes for free. If you do, Void it.”
[*] Merry Expedition changed to "Shuffle target allied Companion into their controllers Deck. Change their Mana Cost to 1I. The next time they enter their controllers Hand, Develop 2 times and draw a Card. If you played a "Bag of Crowns" this turn, draw a Card and Develop."
[*] One Thousand Shining Teeth no longer has Overwhelm.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch revert (IMPORTANT!)
notes.content:
For about 10 minutes today we had a patch live with a bug that stops you from playing Permanents. This has been reverted and fixed, so please update the game again the issue will be fixed.

Apologies, we're trying to work very quickly right now to cover as many topics as we can. We've taken measures to prevent an issue like this from happening again.

notes.title: Patch 03.02.2021
notes.content:
Added Chinese translation.

Ashes now show the newest card first.

notes.title: Patch 03.02.2021
notes.content: Minor UI fixes, optimization and connectivity improvements.

notes.title: Patch 02.02.2021
notes.content:
Reworked card frames and card text. Readability of cards should be drastically improved.

Improved main menu buttons. Still WIP.

Performance optimization.

Balance
Stolen From The Dark changed to: Void a non-Avatar Companion from either Ashes. Restore health to yourself equal to their attack. Once a turn, if Stolen From The Dark is in your Ashes, after an allied Avatar enters the Story give the Avatar +2/+1. Then, at the end of your turn, return Stolen From The Dark to your Hand.

Null dreams first ability to 3N.

Null Dreams second ability requires 3 cards to be voided.

Resonance mana cost increased to 2N1A2I.

Forgotten mana cost changed to 2V.

The Headsman’s Axe mana cost increased to 1N1V.

Just A Small Favor mana cost increased to 3N2I.

Just A Small Favor text changed to: Choose one. If you played a “Bag of Crowns” this turn, choose two instead: Develop; disarm all opposing Companions; deal 3 damage to all opposing Companions; or deal 5 damage to any target.

Hexpainter stats increased to 3/2. Dawn damage reduced to 2.

Planar Skew mana cost increased to 3N3I3V.

Gratitude mana cost increased to 2N1I2D. Span decreased to 4.

Maul retreat no longer shares cooldown with Maul enter.

This means Maul enter and Maul retreat now cool down independently. Example: Maul enters. Maul enter is now on cooldown for 2 turns. Next turn. Maul enter CD is now 1. Maul retreats. End turn. Maul enter CD is now 0. Maul can enter again.

This also means Maul can now retreat and enter again in the same turn if it’s been 2 turns since Maul entered.

This has no effect on how Maul being removed from the Story currently works.

Make Maul not targetable by copy effects.

Removed Preparing Primordiums Dusk.

Garden of Thunder to 4 and 6 damage. Mana cost to 3N5I.

Epigone no longer develops.

Siege Baron secondary now deals 1 damage per 6 cards.

For Hire, For Sale mana cost increased to 1N1I.

Omnibroker mana cost increased to 3N2I2D.

Eir primary mana cost increased to 3N.

Drinks-Deep-Magics changed to Dawn: I destroy target Enchantment. Then I lose my Card text and become an Enchantment Companion with its effect and current Span for the rest of the game.

notes.title: Patch 31.01.2021
notes.content:
Added a gameplay tutorial. This tutorial covers the basics. We’re going to add an additional tutorial with some more advanced mechanics as well soon.

Updated the visual for Companions being able to attack. This is still a bit work in progress, feedback is appreciated.

Fixed the wrong Ashes count bug and deck saving bug.

Improved the optimization.

Added a welcome message for new players.

Fixed wrong hero ability tooltips.

Adjust rank floors from every 1000 MMR to every 500 MMR. Once you reach a rank floor you can’t drop below it anymore.

[h2]Immediate plans[/h2]

Add tutorial 2.

Add Chinese translation.

Release a new balance patch.

Improve feedback and responsiveness of main menu UI.

Adjust card frames to increase readability.

notes.title: Patch 28.01.2021
notes.content:
Hey, welcome to the first patch of many. Thank you very much for playing Chroma. We're aware that there are a variety of UI issues that require work and I promise you: We're on it! Our immediate plans are entirely centered around improving the UI and easing the learning curve. Onto the patch notes:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which caused Emotes to be displayed twice in the inventory.
[*] Added deckbuilder tooltips.
[*] Fixed the options menu not always remembering your selected options.
[*] Fixed various minor issues with the lore page.
[*] Fixed various minor issues with the inventory page.
[/list]
